seeds.name: Wheat Seeds
seeds.desc: Plant them in a dirt plot, then keep them watered.

carrot-seeds.name: Carrot Seeds
carrot-seeds.desc: Carrots grow fast. Plant them in a dirt plot.

pumpkin-seeds.name: Pumpkin Seeds
pumpkin-seeds.desc: Pumpkins take a long time to grow, but they are worth it.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.desc: Harvested from the farm. The farmer pays for it. Eat it to heal a heart.

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.desc: Crunchy. Sells at the market. Eat it to heal a heart.

pumpkin.name: Pumpkin
pumpkin.desc: A big pumpkin. Sells for a good price. Eat it to heal two hearts.

herb.name: Herb
herb.desc: A fragrant wild herb. Useful for brewing, one day.

wood.name: Wood
wood.desc: Chopped from trees. Sell it or use it to repair an axe.

stone.name: Stone
stone.desc: Broken out of rocks. Repairs pickaxes.

lantern.name: Heartwood Lantern
lantern.desc: A gift from the treant. It never needs oil. Lights the way into dark caves.

crest-stone.name: Crest Stone
crest-stone.desc: Carved with a ninja crest. Granite guarded it for the cave builders. It fits the stone door.

crystal.name: Glow Crystal
crystal.desc: A softly glowing crystal. Moths love it.

crystal-lantern.name: Crystal Lantern
crystal-lantern.desc: The Bat Queen's lantern. It shines much brighter than yours, and it may reveal hidden things.

axe.desc: Chops trees. Wears out with use.

pickaxe.desc: Breaks rocks and boulders. Wears out with use.
